Content: there (far from speaker, far from addressee).
Ug didtu siya, nagpaábut ni Maríya,
And there he was waiting for Mary.
— nga [noun]-a
in that [noun] as opposed to other places.
there (at a point in time in the past).
Didtu ku makat-un sa paghigugma níya,
It was then I learned to love him.
There was s.o. there on the sidewalk.
